description: This PHP class defines an import map configuration for importing TSV (Tab Separated Values) files in the SuiteCRM/SugarCRM framework. It extends the ImportMapOther class, specifies properties such as the delimiter (tab character) and enclosure, and includes licensing information and metadata comments.

classes.name: ImportMapTab
classes.description: A class that configures import settings specifically for TSV files in SuiteCRM. It extends ImportMapOther and sets properties like the delimiter (tab character) and enclosure.

methods.name: ImportMapTab
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the import map with predefined properties such as name, delimiter, and enclosure for TSV files.
